title: Apple supplier Jabil, Adani partner to build AI data center infra platform in India
title_zh: 苹果供应商捷普和阿达尼合作在印度建设人工智能数据中心基础设施平台
summary: June 15 (Reuters) - Electronics manufacturer Jabil and India's Adani Enterprises on Monday announced a partnership to build an integrated AI and data center infrastructure manufacturing platform in
summary_zh: 路透 6 月 15 日 - 电子制造商捷普 (Jabil) 和印度阿达尼企业 (Adani Enterprises) 周一宣布建立合作伙伴关系，在印度建立集成人工智能和数据中心基础设施制造平台。

title: SpaceX stock gains: What its IPO signals about its future success
title_zh: SpaceX 股价上涨：其 IPO 预示着其未来的成功
summary: SpaceX stock (SPCX) continues rising in Monday's pre-market trading (maintaining gains at the session open at the time of this video's posting) ahead of the space company's first full day of trading since its historic IPO last Friday.
summary_zh: SpaceX 股票 (SPCX) 在周一盘前交易中继续上涨（在该视频发布时开盘时保持上涨），这是该太空公司自上周五历史性 IPO 以来的第一个全日交易。

title: Indian officials survey farms around Tata iPhone parts plant after water pollution warning

summary_zh: 印度霍苏尔 6 月 15 日（路透社）——印度官员加强了对班加罗尔附近苹果供应商塔塔 iPhone 零部件工厂周围农田的检查。
